about.p: Software Engineer • ADS Technologist • AI & Data Science Postgraduate Student
about.content:
I'm a technology professional with a solid trajectory, combining the resilience of high-level technical support with the innovation of data analysis. Recently, I consolidated my academic foundation with the title of Technologist in Systems Analysis and Development and I'm currently specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at Anhanguera.

My background includes:
• Technical Mastery: Extensive experience as a Level 2 IT Technician, with expertise in network infrastructure, Microsoft Entra ID, and 365 environment management.
• Strategic Vision: Certified in Product Management from the University of Alberta and Scrum Master, focused on delivering real value through agile methodologies.
• Security and Data: Advanced training in Cybersecurity through the Hackers do Bem program and professional certifications from Google and IBM.

More than solving technical problems, I seek to transform data into decisions and infrastructures into secure, intelligent platforms. I'm a constant learner, hardware modding enthusiast, and always ready for the next complex challenge.
